scene.ofreeRecent: A brightly fluorescent modern indoor skating rink concession counter — She buys a small cup of shaved ice after her first lap in years and waits as the color settles across it; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a starship galley and mess hall — pours tea from a small teapot into a cup on the table; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; A modern apartment reading nook at night — She reaches for the little prism at the end of a chapter and splashes a rectangle of lamplight across the wall; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; the inside of a quiet subway car — standing; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — crouching low on her heels

generation.free_design:
Place: A dawn aquatic training bay inside a futuristic floodgate complex, with a dry observation deck above a calm practice channel.
Activity: She checks a little floating course marker against dawn light. At the end of the reach the flexible shoulder panel of the swim jacket folds inward and exposes the outside of her shoulder.
Pose: Seated on a low steel bench facing three quarters toward camera, her right hand raises the marker to eye level and her left hand rests on the edge of the bench.
Framing: A chest-height three-quarter portrait from the dry deck with her face, both hands, the marker and the practice channel visible.
Outfit: An opaque ultramarine crossover swim top with white keel seams and a secure pair of matching high-waisted swimming shorts, with a cropped single-sleeve neoprene jacket that folds at the shoulder.
